label: PC message
description: Shows a notification on the PC's screen, or has the PC read a sentence aloud.

send.label: Send a message to the PC
send.description: Shows the text as a notification (toast) on the PC. Up to 200 characters.

text.label: Message
text.description: The text to show on the PC (up to 200 characters)

speak.label: Read aloud on the PC
speak.description: Has the PC read the text aloud. Up to 200 characters.

text.label: Text to read
text.description: The text the PC reads aloud (up to 200 characters)
